## What Is an Ameritas Internship?


An Ameritas internship is a paid, mostly year-round role at Ameritas Life Insurance Corp., a mutual-based insurer founded in 1887 and headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska. Interns join working teams in IT, cybersecurity, data, audit, investments, marketing and talent development rather than a separate intern track. Ameritas sells individual life and disability insurance, dental and vision benefits, retirement plans and wealth management. Its[careers page](https://www.ameritas.com/careers/) lists 2,500 employees and 6.3 million customers and describes "a large and popular internship program." Its[about page](https://www.ameritas.com/about/) shows an A+ rating from S&P and an A from AM Best.


## When Do Ameritas Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


Ameritas posted its 2027 internships between August 31 and September 23, 2026, about eight months before the main May 2027 start. Last cycle looks the same: the May 2026 roles first appear in archived copies of the board in late August 2025. There's no single deadline. Each posting stays up at least three business days and comes down when it's filled, which is how the summer 2027 actuarial internship disappeared on September 30. A few roles start earlier, in January, spring or April 2027. Applications for summer 2028, including actuarial, are expected in late August to September 2027.

### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


Ameritas hires on a rolling basis, and each posting can close quickly. The only deadline language is "This position will be open for a minimum of 3 business days or until filled," so a role can come down any week once a hire is made. That has already happened this cycle: the summer 2027 actuarial internship went up in September and was removed on September 30, 2026, and a January 2027 data analyst internship is also gone from the board. With 18 roles still live in early October, apply this month rather than waiting for spring.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


Ameritas states its requirements role by role. The common lines across the 18 postings:


• **Enrollment:** enrolled in a college program for the whole internship, at least half-time on most postings. IT Endpoint, IT Support Center and Commercial Mortgage Finance accept associate and bachelor's students; UX requires a Master's program.


• **Class year:** mostly unstated; Sales Development prefers sophomores or juniors.


• **GPA:** none of the 18 postings names a minimum GPA.


• **Work authorization:** 17 of 18 say the role "is not open to individuals who are temporarily authorized to work in the U.S." Some job boards tag Ameritas as open to student visas; the employer's posting governs.


• **Schedule:** 16 of 18 ask you to commit to 12 months or more, part-time during the school year and full-time in summer, mostly hybrid in Lincoln.


### Can You Do the School-Year Part of an Ameritas Internship?


This is the real gate, more than grades. Most Ameritas internships keep going after summer at 10 to 25 hours a week, usually with some office days in Lincoln, so they suit students at nearby schools. If you can't commit to that, three roles fit better: UX and Commercial Mortgage Finance are 3-month summer internships, and Data Analytics - Business Intelligence is remote in the US, though it's still long-term.


## What Skills Does Ameritas Look For, and How Do You Build Them?


Almost every Ameritas posting asks for **communication** : 16 of 18 name written and verbal communication skills. On top of that, **tech roles** (IT, cybersecurity, data science) ask for analytical and troubleshooting skills, the software development lifecycle and data work; **business roles** (audit, finance, marketing, sales) ask for Microsoft Office, writing and proofreading, organization and presenting. A newer thread runs through six postings: using AI, from building generative AI tools to finding ways AI can improve workflows.

## What Is the Ameritas Application and Interview Process Like?


Ameritas publishes its postings but not its interview steps. What the postings do tell you:


1. **Search the Intern filter.** Every role is a separate posting on the ADP board, so apply to each role you want.


2. **Check the fit lines before you apply.** Each posting states the school-year commitment, the office schedule (Lincoln, Cincinnati or remote) and the work authorization line.


3. **Apply on ADP.** Upload your resume; the Videography posting also welcomes a portfolio in any format.


4. **Interviews.** Ameritas doesn't describe its rounds, and we found no first-hand intern account. Prepare short stories about a project you finished, how you'd balance part-time work with classes, and, for tech roles, how you troubleshoot.


5. **Start.** Most roles begin in May 2027; Data Science and Generative A.I. starts in January, IT Architecture in January or May, IT Support Center in spring and Sales Training and Education in April.


Our[behavioral interview guide](https://www.extern.com/post/behavioral-interview-questions-star-method-guide) shows how to build those stories.

## How Do You Stand Out for an Ameritas Internship?


Three moves. **First, apply in October.** Postings close when they're filled, and the actuarial role is already gone. **Second, show you can do the whole year.** Most roles run 12 months with part-time school-year hours, so say plainly in your application which hours you can work and how close you are to Lincoln or Cincinnati. **Third, aim at the roles with a pathway.** The TechTrek IT cohort says completion "may provide participants with preferred consideration for full-time associate roles," and the cybersecurity intern can earn a funded ISC2 certification after six months. Ameritas has[profiled interns](https://www.ameritas.com/newsroom/intern-to-full-time-journey-at-ameritas/) who moved into full-time jobs, but it publishes no applicant count or conversion rate.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 Ameritas internship?


No. The summer 2026 interns started in May 2026. The open door now is the 2027 group: on October 5, 2026 Ameritas had 18 intern postings live, most starting in May 2027 and some in January, spring or April 2027. The summer 2027 actuarial internship has already closed.


### When do Ameritas internship applications close?


There's no fixed deadline. Each posting says it stays open "a minimum of 3 business days or until filled," so roles close one by one as they're filled. The summer 2027 actuarial internship came down on September 30, 2026. Apply in October rather than waiting for spring.


### How much do Ameritas interns make?


Every Ameritas internship posting lists $13.33 to $26.67 an hour. Ameritas says it's a nationwide range and the final rate depends on the role, location, skills and experience, so don't assume the top of the range. Internships are paid but not eligible for benefits.


### Is an Ameritas internship a summer internship?


Mostly not. Sixteen of the 18 live postings run 12 months or more: full-time, 30 to 40 hours a week, in summer and part-time, about 10 to 25 hours, during the school year. Only the UX and Commercial Mortgage Finance internships are 3-month summer roles.


### Where are Ameritas internships located?


Most are hybrid at the Lincoln, Nebraska headquarters. Four roles can be in Lincoln or Cincinnati, Ohio: UX, Commercial Mortgage Finance, IT Architecture and Cybersecurity. IT Endpoint and IT Support Center need daily office time in Lincoln, and Data Analytics - Business Intelligence is remote in the US.


### Can international students apply for Ameritas internships?


Probably not. Seventeen of the 18 postings say the role "is not open to individuals who are temporarily authorized to work in the U.S.," which rules out most student-visa work permission. Some job boards tag Ameritas as visa-friendly, but the employer's own posting is the one to follow.


### Does Ameritas hire interns full-time?


Sometimes, but it publishes no conversion rate. The TechTrek IT cohort says completion may give participants preferred consideration for full-time associate roles, and Ameritas has profiled interns who moved into full-time jobs. Because most internships last a year, you build a long track record before any full-time decision.


### When is the next Ameritas actuarial internship?


The summer 2027 actuarial internship was removed on September 30, 2026. Based on the last two cycles, applications for summer 2028 are expected in late August to September 2027. Last cycle's posting asked for an actuarial science degree and Interest Theory or one exam passed.


Ameritas fills its 2027 internships role by role, so apply this month. While you wait to hear back, a[remote Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships) gives you a finished project to discuss in your interviews.
